critical.title: ⚡ BAH — Q2 FY2027 EARNINGS RELEASED, EPS GUIDE RAISED
critical.text: Booz Allen released Q2 FY27 on 10/23 (SEC 8-K Ex. 99.1; figures from a summarised fetch of the exhibit): revenue $2.78B (−3.9% y/y), adjusted EBITDA $313M (−3.4%, 11.3% margin), adjusted diluted EPS $1.76 (+18.1%), backlog $40.9B (+1.9%), book-to-bill 1.5×. The release does not mention the tax-records/DOJ matter. The $78.57 prior close (10/22, +4.70%) does not reflect the release, so the market reaction is unknown until the open. Lens impact: supports more upside left (Upside Left stays 🟡 until targets move); sell zone stays 🟢 TOO EARLY — tracking only, no shares until June 2027.
